questions: Section 5 says both lipid tables are in force but refers to judgement where two tables point at different bands. On this file total cholesterol 323 falls in the 75 band and the TC/HDL ratio 5.3 falls in the 25 band. Is house practice to charge both tables cumulatively (100) or only the higher of the two (75)?

Section 16 refers combinations of cardiac risk factors to judgement. This applicant has total cholesterol 323 with ratio 5.3, tobacco quit within the last 5 years, diagnosed sleep apnea with no CPAP in use, diastolic 86 and A1c 6.0. Does the house add a further debit or cap the rating class for that combination beyond the sum of the individual table charges, and if so by how much?

Total cholesterol 323 is on file with no lipid therapy noted. Is it house practice to postpone for a repeat lipid panel or attending physician statement at this level, or to rate it on the table as it stands?
